html:
Question 4
?

Which of the following gives the area bounded between the curve defined parametrically as x=e−tsin⁡t,y=tet and the x-axis for t∈[−π2,0]?

a
∫−π/20et(cos⁡t−sin⁡t)dt
b
∫−π/20t(sin⁡t−cos⁡t)dt
c
−∫−π/20tcos⁡tdt
d
∫−π/20e−t(cos⁡t−sin⁡t)dt
e
−∫−π/20e−tsin⁡tdt
Submit
